data.one_liner: ListView that scrolls infinitely in both directions.
data.what_it_does: Provides a drop‑in replacement for ListView that can scroll without bounds forward and backward. It uses a builder pattern to generate items on demand and supports null safety and const construction.
use_when: You need an endlessly scrolling list in both directions without managing indices yourself.
You want a simple widget replacement for ListView to achieve infinite scrolling.
avoid_when: The list has a known finite size.
You require complex pagination or data‑fetching logic beyond simple infinite scrolling.
Performance is critical for extremely large data sets.
strengths: Infinite scrolling both forward and backward
Null‑safe and can be declared const
Easy drop‑in replacement for existing ListView
weaknesses: Limited to simple infinite scrolling use‑cases
May not handle very large or complex data efficiently
Customization options are fewer than a full custom scroll implementation
